title: Get your foreign qualification recognised
whatHappens: If your previous qualification was issued outside Italy, it usually needs a *Dichiarazione di Valore in Loco* — a consulate document confirming how it compares to the Italian system — or a comparability statement from CIMEA, an Italian body built for exactly this purpose.
whoDecides: The Italian consulate in your country, or CIMEA, depending on which route you use.
timing: Same window as pre-registration — generally April to June. It takes time to process, so start early.
whatCanGoWrong: Requesting the wrong document for your situation costs weeks you don't have.
whatKimereDoes: We tell you which route applies to your qualification and help you prepare the paperwork correctly the first time.
